title: Contact Leaving Egypt — Begin Your Journey

hero.title: Reach out. We'd be glad to hear from you.
hero.lede: Whether you have a question, want to learn more, or are ready to take a first step, there's a place for you below. A real person reads every message.

interest.title: Take the first step
interest.intro: This is a short, low-pressure way to start. Tell us where you'd most like to grow, and we'll follow up with the current details and simple next steps.
bullets: No cost or commitment to reach out.
Your information is only used to reply to you.

general.title: Send us a message
general.intro: Have a question, a partnership idea, or a speaking request? Use the form and choose the reason that fits best. We'll get back to you.
general.directEmailNote: Replace with the client's permanent email before launch (see README).

safety.title: A note on safety and privacy
safety.body: Please don't send sensitive medical, financial, legal, mental-health, or confidential personal details through these forms. If you or someone you know is in crisis or immediate danger, contact emergency services right away—call or text 988 (U.S. Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or call 911. Leaving Egypt is not a crisis service. See our Privacy Policy and Disclaimer for more.
